Get results from documents processed by spaCy (deprecated)

Source: R/parse-extractor-functions.R
get-functions.Rd

These functions are deprecated, and will be removed in a future version of spacyr. They give a warning on every call. spacy_parse() returns all of their results in one data.frame, one row per token:

  • get_tokens(): the token column;

  • get_tags(): the pos column, or tag with spacy_parse(x, tag = TRUE);

  • get_attrs(): spacy_parse(x, additional_attributes = attr_name);

  • get_named_entities(): the entity column;

  • get_dependency(): the head_token_id and dep_rel columns of spacy_parse(x, dependency = TRUE). Note that head_token_id numbers the tokens within each sentence, while the head_id of get_dependency() numbers them within each document. To number the head tokens within each document, add the number of tokens in the document's earlier sentences:

    parsed <- spacy_parse(x, dependency = TRUE)
head_id <- parsed$head_token_id +
  ave(seq_len(nrow(parsed)), parsed$doc_id, FUN = seq_along) -
  parsed$token_id

  • get_ntokens() and get_ntokens_by_sent(): count the rows by doc_id, and by doc_id and sentence_id;

  • get_noun_phrases(): spacy_extract_nounphrases().

Each reads the documents held by the result of process_document(), which are not affected by later calls to other spacyr functions.

Usage

get_tokens(spacy_out)

get_tags(spacy_out, tagset = c("google", "detailed"))

get_attrs(spacy_out, attr_name, deal_utf8 = FALSE)

get_named_entities(spacy_out)

get_dependency(spacy_out)

get_noun_phrases(spacy_out)

get_ntokens(spacy_out)

get_ntokens_by_sent(spacy_out)

Arguments

spacy_out

the result of process_document()

tagset

character label for the tagset to use, either "google" or "detailed" to use the simplified Google tagset, or the more detailed scheme from the Penn Treebank (or the German Text Archive in case of German language model).

attr_name

name of spaCy token attributes to extract

deal_utf8

not used; kept for compatibility

Value

get_tokens() returns a character vector of the tokens of all the documents.

get_tags() returns a character vector of the part-of-speech tags of all the tokens.

get_attrs() returns the values of the attribute for all the tokens.

get_named_entities() returns a character vector of the entity tags of all the tokens.

get_dependency() returns a list of the head token IDs (head_id) and the dependency relations (dep_rel) of all the tokens.

get_noun_phrases() returns a data.frame of noun phrases.

get_ntokens() returns the number of tokens in each document.

get_ntokens_by_sent() returns a list of the number of tokens in each sentence, for each document.
